g.text: With individual jumper wires, you can leave Grove 4 EMPTY. No firmware change.

text.style: font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px;fill: rgb(32%,40%,49%); stroke:none;

g.text: Both encoder pin 1 wires share GND. Both pin 4 wires need their rated encoder supply.

text.style: font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: Distribute encoder power/GND through a small breadboard or terminal block; use 3.3 V only if rated.

text.style: font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: Keep motor power (pins 5/6) on M1/M2. Never join left A and right A together.
